description: Vriddhi is a full-featured, role-based academic management platform for colleges. It brings students, faculty, college administration, and platform operators onto a single system covering attendance, assessments and tests, curriculum, question banks, AI-assisted paper generation, fees, timetables, and more — powered by Firebase and modern React.
